# Sun Optics

> Sun Optics is an optician in Vellore, Tamil Nadu, caring for eyes since December 1999. It offers eye check-ups by optometrists, eyewear, lenses, contact lenses, and specialty contact lens fitting (corneal RGP, scleral, orthokeratology) and vision therapy. Two branches: Krishna Nagar and Green Circle.

## Key facts
- Founder: Mr. Balaji, optometrist with over three decades of experience; Mr. Yashwanth Balaji, B.Optom, leads specialty contact lens and vision therapy services
- Eye check-up: ₹200, free when frames and lenses are purchased; walk-ins welcome
- Appointments recommended for keratoconus and corneal irregularity fittings, specialty contact lenses and vision therapy
- Timings: 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM, all week (Sunday timings may vary; call to confirm)
- Home delivery: free within Vellore and surrounding areas; courier service for outer regions
- Contact: +91 95665 14555 (call or WhatsApp)
- Orders and enquiries are handled by call or WhatsApp; there is no online checkout

## Branches
- Sun Optics, Krishna Nagar Branch (since 1999): TKT Complex, 1, Officer's Line, near Lakshmi Theatre, opp. Allen Solly showroom, Krishna Nagar, Veerasamy Nagar, Vellore, Tamil Nadu 632001
- Sun Optics, Green Circle: 6/1, Katpadi Main Road, Green Circle, Vellore, Tamil Nadu 632004
